caption: The drawing depicts a single, rounded jug placed centrally on a plain, off-white or beige background framed by a hand-drawn rectangular border. The jug has a bulbous lower body, a narrower, short neck, a spout at the top, and a curved handle attached from the upper neck to the midsection. The jug appears to be made of a dark, glossy material, with shades of deep brown, black, and purple, and some subtle lighter highlights reflecting off the surface. The base of the jug is a lighter brown, indicating possible exposure of an unglazed ceramic bottom. In the upper left corner, a smaller, rectangular inset displays a close-up detail of the jug’s handle from a top-down or angled perspective, rendered with the same dark colors and shiny surface effect. The overall composition is simple and centered, focusing solely on the jug and its handle without any additional decorative or background elements.
title: Pitcher
